اعلوطا (form XIII)
# اِعْلَوَّطَا (iʕlawwaṭā) /iʕ.law.wa.tˤaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِعْلَوَّطَ (iʕlawwaṭa)
# اُعْلُوِّطَا (uʕluwwiṭā) /uʕ.luw.wi.tˤaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِعْلَوَّطَ (iʕlawwaṭa)
# اِعْلَوِّطَا (iʕlawwiṭā) /iʕ.law.wi.tˤaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِعْلَوَّطَ (iʕlawwaṭa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
